title: DCLab Code's attached images counted, never kept
request: Continue without stopping, and capture, record and store data for training the six models.
plan: Count the images attached in this repository's DCLab Code sessions as the agents keeper counts screenshots
Never keep an image's bytes; never count another folder's

decisions.why: no redaction can read a picture; the image stays whole on the owner's Mac
a symlinked session folder could point at a client's files

findings.defect: a symlinked session folder was followed
findings.scenario: a link from attachments/<session> to a client folder would count the names and hashes of its images
findings.fix: a linked attachments or records folder is not read

measurements.name: keeper tests and the store check
measurements.gate: the keeper tests pass and the store check passes all its checks
measurements.result: test_store_dclab_code 5 and test_store_agents 4 passed; store check 28 of 28

outcome: The store knows each image the person attached in a session on this repository, by name, size and hash, and keeps none.
lessons: Count what cannot be redacted; keep it only where it was made
